task.description:
Review the test spec and E2E test files for PD-UI-09 through PD-UI-12. This is a HARD GATE — FAIL immediately if any check fails. Verify:
1. Every MUST requirement has a runnable E2E Playwright test file
2. No test.skip on any MUST requirement test
3. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs (no collision risk)
4. Tests clean up after themselves (delete created resources)
5. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (no silent skip)
6. No mocks, stubs, or HTTP-level mocking (DIRECTIVE T-2)
7. Screenshots taken after every significant UI action (DIRECTIVE T-3)
acceptance_criteria: FAIL result with issue list if any check fails

result.summary: All 7 validation checks passed for PD-UI-09 through PD-UI-12 E2E tests.
